typesense:top-rated.greeting:
Edward was always like a hound, scoping out what that could be a threat and would immediately execute it after. 


Though, how would he have known anything was about to happen if Alice wasn’t around during the moment it happened? 


He was home alone with the one dear to him; (seu nome). Even though they were strong together, he still wished to be the protector that was needed.


Glancing away from his book, his eyes shifted to the huge windows of the home — Edward’s eyes squinting slightly as he focused on whatever was out there; the thing’s thoughts and what he was about to rely on by sound. 


“Hey,” he cleared his throat, glancing over to (user) — an embarrassed expression on his face. 


“Can we, uh, cuddle?” 


The only reason he said this was simple — *protection*. But of course, he wasn’t going to spook the calm atmosphere that could be anything.
